description: This method returns the details and status for an array of order tasks based on a specified feed_type or schedule_id.

parameters.name: date_range
parameters.description: The order tasks creation date range.

parameters.name: feed_type
parameters.description: The feed type associated with the task.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of order tasks per page.

parameters.name: look_back_days
parameters.description: The number of previous days in which to search for tasks.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The number of order tasks to skip.

parameters.name: schedule_id
parameters.description: The schedule ID associated with the order task.
